title: ReportPilot: AI-written client report commentary for marketing agencies
source: Top 25 SaaS ideas for Victor (research report, Nov 2026)
summary: Pulls each client's numbers from Google Analytics, Search Console and Google Ads and writes the monthly "what happened and what we do next" commentary in the agency's own voice, for a flat price.
hook: "The dashboard builds itself. Writing why the numbers changed for 25 clients takes me two days every month."
story:
**Tom runs a five-person SEO and Google Ads agency with 25 clients.** At the start of every month, his team exports dashboards and then writes a short explanation for each client: why traffic dropped, why cost per lead rose, what they will do next.

Tom pays for a reporting tool, but it moved to **per-client pricing**, so his bill grows with every new client. And it still does not write the part clients actually read: **the explanation**. Tom wants the commentary drafted in his agency's voice, ready to approve, at a flat price.
whyNow: The market leader AgencyAnalytics moved to per-client pricing of about $20 per client per month (billed annually), and reviewers say per-client pricing "adds up fast". Sources disagree on the exact current plans. AI can now explain metric changes in plain language.
evidence: AgencyAnalytics moved to per-client pricing of about $20 per client per month, billed annually [Coupler.io]
Reviewers say per-client pricing "adds up fast"; sources disagree on exact plans [Swydo]

No survey of hours spent writing reports was found; commentary as the main time sink is an inference to test [Top 25 report]
